caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron balcony railing rendered in black ink lines on a light beige background. The railing is shown from the front and slightly above, revealing its curvature and attachment to a tiled balcony floor. The design of the railing features symmetrical, ornate scrollwork with flowing curves, spirals, and oval shapes. The central panel contains a circular medallion made from interlacing wrought iron scrolls, flanked by large curved elements that mirror each other on either side. Vertical oval shapes and circular joints connect the decorative elements at the top and bottom horizontal rails. Behind the railing, partial outlines of building features are visible, including the edge of a brick wall to the left and open window shutters to the right. The drawing includes precise measurements on the right edge, and the caption "WROUGHT IRON BALCONY RAILING" appears in uppercase letters in the lower right corner.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony
